purpose: Stage measured multimodal journey continuity into the existing runtime-state-v1 Formula adapter without modifying LEEWAY-FORMULA-v1.0. This contract does not authorize Formula execution until ranges are calibrated and Veritas accepts the mapping.

dimensions.definition: authoritative next-leg departure minus max(now, authoritative current-leg arrival) minus required transfer time
dimensions.role: time margin for the next connection

dimensions.definition: now minus timestamp of the newest source-reported moving-asset observation
geodesic or route-network distance from the currently tracked subject/user position to the next transfer point
source-published predicted or actual event time minus source-published scheduled event time
dimensions.role: early/late condition without inferring ETA from position alone

dimensions.definition: number of source-backed active alerts, closures, cancellations or service disruptions relevant to the current and next journey legs
dimensions.role: external operational pressure on the journey

dimensions.definition: authoritative required journey fields currently present divided by required journey fields for the evaluated decision
dimensions.role: how much of the connection decision is supported by source-backed evidence

observationWindow.rule: 16 consecutive journey observations for the same itinerary identity, transfer sequence, source authorities and calibration profile

prohibitions: Do not infer transit arrival time from GPS position alone.
Do not infer aircraft gate, terminal, departure or arrival schedule from ADS-B position alone.
Do not infer vessel berth or port schedule from AIS position alone.
Do not promote mapped geometry or simulation to live evidence.
Do not call LEEWAY-FORMULA-v1.0 until calibrated ranges and the task mapping are verified.

deterministicBaseline.rule: Connection state may be computed directly from authoritative arrival/departure timestamps and minimum transfer time while Formula mapping remains unverified.

veritasAcceptance: Every timestamp carries source, retrieval time and truth state.
Every moving subject identity remains stable across updates.
GPS position alone never becomes ETA.
Connection slack reproduces exactly from the same timestamps and transfer rule.
All six dimensions have measured calibration ranges before Formula use.
Canonical Formula engine and runtime-state adapter hashes match authority pins.
A Formula result is not presented as route, schedule, safety or factual-world proof by itself.
reason: Domain mapping is newly staged for multimodal journey continuity. Calibration, Formula execution and Veritas contribution testing have not occurred.
